<div class="notes">

<div class="notes-heading">Data summary</div>
<ul>
  <li><strong>26 countries</strong> — top 20 by population plus <a href="https://www.oecd.org/about/members-and-partners/">OECD</a> member states</li>
  <li><strong>14 causes of death</strong> — 7 <a href="https://www.who.int/health-topics/noncommunicable-diseases">non-communicable</a> + 7 <a href="https://www.who.int/health-topics/infectious-diseases">infectious</a></li>
  <li><strong>Metric:</strong> age-standardised death rate per 100,000 population</li>
  <li><strong>Source:</strong> <a href="https://www.healthdata.org/research-analysis/gbd"><abbr title="Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation">IHME</abbr> Global Burden of Disease</a> 2019, via <a href="https://ourworldindata.org/causes-of-death"><abbr title="Our World in Data">OWID</abbr></a> catalog (snapshot <code>2024-05-20</code>)</li>
  <li>Percentage shares are relative to these 14 tracked causes only — <strong>not</strong> 100% of all-cause mortality</li>
</ul>

<div class="notes-heading">Exclusions</div>
<ul>
  <li><strong>Ireland</strong> — listed in the download script's country filter (<code>IRL</code>) but absent from the bundled OWID snapshot. Requires <a href="https://www.healthdata.org/data-tools-practices/interactive-visuals/gbd-results">IHME GBD Results Tool</a> direct download — see <a href="https://github.com/JohnGavin/micromort/issues/94">#94</a></li>
  <li><strong>Injuries</strong> (road accidents, self-harm, violence, falls, drowning) — a major cause-of-death category, especially in younger age groups. Not yet included — see <a href="https://github.com/JohnGavin/micromort/issues/91">#91</a></li>
  <li><strong>Maternal and neonatal deaths</strong> — account for ~10% of deaths in low-income countries. Not yet included</li>
  <li><strong>Other <abbr title="Non-communicable diseases">NCD</abbr>s</strong> (neurological, mental, musculoskeletal) — not in the 7 tracked NCD categories</li>
</ul>

<div class="stale">
<strong>Data staleness warning</strong><br>
<a href="https://www.healthdata.org/research-analysis/gbd"><abbr title="Global Burden of Disease study">GBD</abbr></a> data year: <strong>2019</strong> — the most recent year in the bundled snapshot.<br>
OWID catalog date: <strong>2024-05-20</strong> — this URL now returns HTTP 404. OWID restricted GBD redistribution due to IHME licensing changes.<br>
<a href="https://ghdx.healthdata.org/record/ihme-data/gbd-2023-cause-specific-mortality-1990-2023">GBD 2023</a> is available from IHME (free account required) — see <a href="https://github.com/JohnGavin/micromort/issues/90">#90</a>.
</div>

<div class="notes-heading">Glossary</div>
<ul>
  <li><a href="https://www.healthdata.org/research-analysis/gbd"><abbr title="Global Burden of Disease study: comprehensive assessment of mortality and disability from diseases, injuries, and risk factors">GBD</abbr></a> — Global Burden of Disease study (IHME)</li>
  <li><a href="https://www.healthdata.org/"><abbr title="Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation: independent research centre at the University of Washington">IHME</abbr></a> — Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation</li>
  <li><a href="https://ourworldindata.org/"><abbr title="Our World in Data: research and data platform covering global development">OWID</abbr></a> — Our World in Data</li>
  <li><a href="https://www.who.int/health-topics/noncommunicable-diseases"><abbr title="Non-communicable diseases: chronic conditions not transmitted between people (CVD, cancer, diabetes, chronic respiratory)">NCD</abbr></a> — Non-communicable diseases</li>
  <li><a href="https://www.who.int/health-topics/cardiovascular-diseases"><abbr title="Cardiovascular disease: diseases of the heart and blood vessels — leading cause of death globally">CVD</abbr></a> — Cardiovascular disease</li>
  <li><a href="https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/pneumonia"><abbr title="Lower respiratory infections: pneumonia and bronchiolitis — leading infectious killer">LRI</abbr></a> — Lower respiratory infections</li>
  <li><a href="https://www.who.int/data/gho/indicator-metadata-registry/imr-details/158"><abbr title="Disability-adjusted life year: 1 DALY = 1 year of healthy life lost to illness, disability, or death">DALY</abbr></a> — Disability-adjusted life year</li>
</ul>

<div class="notes-heading">References</div>
<ul>
  <li>IHME. <em>Global Burden of Disease Study 2019 (GBD 2019) Results.</em> Seattle: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation, 2020. <a href="https://vizhub.healthdata.org/gbd-results/">GBD Results Tool</a></li>
  <li>Ritchie H, Spooner F, Roser M. <em>Causes of death.</em> Our World in Data, 2018 (updated 2024). <a href="https://ourworldindata.org/causes-of-death">ourworldindata.org/causes-of-death</a></li>
  <li>Roth GA et al. <em>Global burden of 369 diseases and injuries, 1990–2019.</em> Lancet 2020; 396:1204–22. <a href="https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(20)30925-9">doi:10.1016/S0140-6736(20)30925-9</a></li>
</ul>
